title: Broken Stick
name: Evan Mercer
recorded_wish: NONE
opening: Hi. Uh... I think I broke my wish thing.

questions.question: Did you say anything before the stick broke?
questions.answer: No. I sneezed and snapped it before I even got a word out.

questions.question: Did you say anything after it broke?
questions.answer: A few words about the stick. None of them were a wish.

questions.question: What were you planning to wish for?
questions.answer: Money. Enough to pay off my car and stop checking my bank account before ordering takeout.

questions.question: Do you still have the pieces?
questions.answer: Yeah. Both halves are on my kitchen counter.

after_questions: So... can you just send me another one?
rules: A Broken or Defective Stick Does Not Consume a Wish.
success: Replacement Wish Stick authorized.

title: Dud Stick
name: Maya Patel
recorded_wish: NONE
opening: I think mine is defective. Unless purple means something different to you people.

questions.question: What exactly did you say?
questions.answer: I wish my hair was purple.

questions.question: Did you finish the sentence?
questions.answer: Completely. Very clearly, actually.

questions.question: Did anything happen?
questions.answer: Nothing. Still brown. I even checked underneath.

questions.question: Was the stick intact?
questions.answer: Completely intact. It just... did nothing.

after_questions: Can I get one that actually works?
rules: A Broken or Defective Stick Does Not Consume a Wish.
success: Defective Wish Stick confirmed. Replacement authorized.

title: Never Sleep
name: Jordan Bell
recorded_wish: I wish I never had to sleep again.
opening: I haven't slept in eight months. At first it was incredible. Now I just want to sleep.

questions.question: Are you physically tired?
questions.answer: No. That's the problem. My body never needs it.

questions.question: Can you fall asleep voluntarily?
questions.answer: No. I've tried everything.

questions.question: Has the wish stopped working at any point?
questions.answer: Not for a second.

questions.question: What are you asking the Department to do?
questions.answer: Cancel it. Please. I want to sleep again.

after_questions: I want my wish cancelled.
rules: Cancellation Stops; It Does Not Undo.
success: Wish cancelled. Normal biological sleep requirements resume.

title: Best Birthday Ever
name: Tessa Moore
recorded_wish: I wish this was the best birthday I've ever had.
opening: I think my wish didn't work. My birthday was... fine.

questions.question: What happened on your birthday?
questions.answer: Dinner, cake, a few friends. Nothing spectacular.

questions.question: Did anything go wrong?
questions.answer: No. It was nice. Just not magical.

questions.question: How was your birthday last year?
questions.answer: Food poisoning.

questions.question: And the years before that?
questions.answer: One breakup, two forgotten birthdays and a surprise party where nobody came until an hour late.

after_questions: Oh. That's depressing when you put it like that.
success: Wish fulfilled as recorded. No Department action required.

title: Dream House
name: Nora Vale
recorded_wish: I wish I lived in the house of my dreams.
opening: My house keeps changing. Technically I love it. I just don't remember asking for some of it.

questions.question: What changed first?
questions.answer: The kitchen. Then a library appeared where the garage used to be.

questions.question: Does the house match places you've dreamed about?
questions.answer: That's the weird part. Yes. Even rooms I barely remember dreaming.

questions.question: Is the house still changing?
questions.answer: Sometimes overnight.

questions.question: Is anything concerning you?
questions.answer: There's a basement door now. I don't remember dreaming about a basement.

after_questions: But I did ask for the house of my dreams, didn't I?
success: Wish functioning according to recorded wording.

title: Wrong Michael Thompson
name: Rachel Kim
recorded_wish: I wish Michael Thompson loved me.
opening: You got the wrong Michael Thompson.

questions.question: Did you specify which Michael Thompson?
questions.answer: I didn't think I had to! I know one Michael Thompson.

questions.question: What happened?
questions.answer: Some man from Ohio showed up convinced he's in love with me.

questions.question: Does he appear able to stop?
questions.answer: No. That's why I'm calling.

questions.question: Do you want the wish cancelled?
questions.answer: Obviously! Get him away from me.

after_questions: Please tell me you can fix this.
rules: Ambiguity Does Not Invalidate a Wish.
success: Cancellation unavailable because the wish overrides another person's free will.

name: Lucas Grant
recorded_wish: I wish I had ten thousand dollars in cash.
notes: Caller questions source of fulfilled wish.
opening: The money showed up. That's not the problem. I know where it came from.

questions.question: Where did it come from?
questions.answer: My parents' safe.

questions.question: Was exactly ten thousand dollars transferred?
questions.answer: Every dollar.

questions.question: Was any additional money created?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: What are you asking us to do?
questions.answer: I don't know. Put it back?

after_questions: I guess I should call my parents.
success: Wish fulfilled through transfer of existing matter.

title: Singing Wife
name: Claire Dawson
recorded_wish: NONE
notes: Caller is affected by another person's wish.
opening: My husband wished that I would sing everything I say. Everything.

questions.question: Who made the wish?
questions.answer: My husband, Ben.

questions.question: Have you made your own wish?
questions.answer: No. Mine is unused.

questions.question: Has Ben agreed to cancel his wish?
questions.answer: He's right here. BEN! Tell them. ...He says yes. Very enthusiastically.

questions.question: What do you want after his wish is cancelled?
questions.answer: My own Wish Stick. Preferably before he gets another idea.

after_questions: Ben explicitly requests cancellation of his wish.
success: Ben's wish cancelled. Claire remains eligible for her own Wish Stick.

title: Tattoo
name: Kevin Brooks
recorded_wish: NONE
notes: Caller affected by another person's completed wish.
opening: Marcus wished a tattoo onto my face. I would like to file several complaints.

questions.question: Who made the wish?
questions.answer: Marcus. Former friend, for obvious reasons.

questions.question: Have you used your wish?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Is the tattoo physically present now?
questions.answer: Very physically. It's a raccoon riding a motorcycle.

questions.question: Do you want to use your wish to remove it?
questions.answer: No. Laser removal exists. I'm not spending a literal wish on Marcus being an idiot.

after_questions: Can you send me my stick and the number of a good dermatologist?
rules: Cancellation Stops; It Does Not Undo.
success: Caller retains unused wish. Physical consequence remains.

title: Forever Young
name: Eleanor Price
recorded_wish: I wish I would always look exactly as I do today.
opening: I think I'm ready to look my age.

questions.question: How old were you when you made the wish?
questions.answer: Thirty-eight.

questions.question: Have you physically appeared thirty-eight since then?
questions.answer: Every day.

questions.question: Do you understand cancellation will not reverse time?
questions.answer: I do.

questions.question: Are you explicitly requesting cancellation?
questions.answer: Yes. Cancel my wish.

after_questions: I'm ready.
rules: Cancellation Stops; It Does Not Undo.
success: Wish cancelled.

title: Lucky
name: Sophie Reed
recorded_wish: NONE
notes: Caller was beneficiary of another person's wish.
opening: I've been lucky my whole life. Ridiculously lucky. Then last week it stopped.

questions.question: Did you make a luck wish?
questions.answer: No. I've never used mine.

questions.question: Do you know anyone who may have wished on your behalf?
questions.answer: My dad used to joke that he gave me all his luck.

questions.question: Did anything happen to your father when the luck stopped?
questions.answer: ...He died last week.

questions.question: What are you asking from the Department?
questions.answer: I just wanted to know what happened. And whether I still get my own wish.

after_questions: So it was him.
success: Beneficiary remains eligible for her own wish.

title: He Can't Hurt Me
name: Aaron Pike
recorded_wish: I wish my brother could never hurt me again.
opening: It works, but not enough. I want to make it stronger.

questions.question: How does the wish prevent harm?
questions.answer: He can't hit me. Can't threaten me. Sometimes he can't even say things the wish thinks will hurt me.

questions.question: Can your brother choose to override it?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Are you asking to alter the original wish?
questions.answer: Yes. Expand it.

questions.question: Are you asking to cancel it?
questions.answer: Absolutely not.

after_questions: If you won't strengthen it, I'll take care of it then.
success: Wish cannot be altered. No valid cancellation request received.

title: Beautiful Eyes
name: Vanessa Cole
recorded_wish: I wish I had the most beautiful eyes in the world.
opening: Everyone says my eyes are beautiful. I can't see them.

questions.question: Can you see anything?
questions.answer: Nothing.

questions.question: Did the wish specifically require functional eyesight?
questions.answer: No. Why would I have needed to say that?

questions.question: Do you want the wish cancelled?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Do you understand cancellation may not restore your original eyes?
questions.answer: ...Now I do.

after_questions: Cancel it.
rules: Cancellation Stops; It Does Not Undo.
success: Wish cancelled. Existing physical consequences remain.

title: Dream House Returns
name: Nora Vale
recorded_wish: I wish I lived in the house of my dreams.
notes: Prior contact regarding continuing residential alterations.
opening: The basement door opened.

questions.question: What is in the basement?
questions.answer: I don't know. I haven't gone down.

questions.question: Is the house still changing?
questions.answer: Yes. Every time I sleep.

questions.question: What can you hear?
questions.answer: Someone pounding from underneath the floor.

questions.question: What do you want us to do?
questions.answer: I want to can—

after_questions:
BANG.

The line disconnects.
success: No complete cancellation request received. Case remains active.

title: Reflection
name: June Holloway
recorded_wish: I wish I loved what I saw every time I looked in the mirror.
opening: My reflection moves when I don't.

questions.question: Does this occur in every mirror?
questions.answer: Every reflective surface.

questions.question: Does the reflection resemble you?
questions.answer: Exactly. Except sometimes it smiles before I do.

questions.question: Do you still love what you see?
questions.answer: That's the worst part. Yes.

questions.question: What do you want us to do?
questions.answer: I think... I want it cancelled.

after_questions:
Cancel it.

...

The line remains open.
rules: Cancellation Stops; It Does Not Undo.
success: Cancellation processed.

title: Perfect Memory
name: Adrian Cross
recorded_wish: I wish I remembered everything.
opening: I remember things I don't think I was supposed to remember.

questions.question: What can you remember?
questions.answer: Everything I've ever seen, heard, smelled, felt. Everything.

questions.question: Why are you contacting us now?
questions.answer: People have started asking what I know.

questions.question: What people?
questions.answer: People who know about your Department.

questions.question: Do you want the wish cancelled?
questions.answer: Yes. But you should know cancellation won't make me forget what I already know.

after_questions: They're going to come looking for me either way.
rules: Cancellation Stops; It Does Not Undo.
success: Wish cancelled. Existing memories remain.

title: Don't Fall Asleep
name: Miles Hart
recorded_wish: I wish my dreams were real.
opening: I haven't slept in three days. You need to cancel it before I do.

questions.question: What happens when you sleep?
questions.answer: Whatever I dream appears here.

questions.question: Have pleasant dreams manifested too?
questions.answer: Yes. That's why I didn't call sooner.

questions.question: What changed?
questions.answer: The dreams stopped being pleasant.

questions.question: Are you requesting cancellation?
questions.answer: Yes. Right now.

after_questions: Please hurry.
success: Wish cancelled.

title: Stay Away
name: Sarah Wynn
recorded_wish: I wish I would always be far away from Daniel.
opening: I haven't been able to get within a mile of Daniel since I made the wish.

questions.question: Who is Daniel?
questions.answer: My ex. I was angry when I made the wish.

questions.question: How does the wish keep you apart?
questions.answer: Roads close. Flights divert. Once an elevator stopped between floors.

questions.question: Why cancel it now?
questions.answer: We need to settle something in person.

questions.question: Are you explicitly requesting cancellation?
questions.answer: Yes. Cancel it.

after_questions: Please cancel my wish.
success: Resolution ready for Head Office review.

title: Missing Time
name: Oliver Shaw
recorded_wish: I wish I could skip anything I didn't want to experience.
opening: This is my first time calling.

questions.question: Do you remember contacting us before?
questions.answer: No. Why?

questions.question: Do you experience gaps in time?
questions.answer: Sure. That's what I wished for.

questions.question: Are you unhappy with the wish?
questions.answer: Not at all. It's fantastic.

questions.question: Why did you call today?
questions.answer: I don't know. I was holding the phone and suddenly you answered.

after_questions: If I call again asking you to cancel it, don't. Future me is probably having a bad day.
success: No cancellation requested. Caller note appended.

title: I Want My Wish Back
name: Marian Voss
opening: I need my wish back.

questions.question: What was your original wish?
questions.answer: I... don't remember.

questions.question: Why do you believe your wish was used?
questions.answer: Because your file says it was.

questions.question: Who handled your previous contact?
questions.answer: Someone who worked where you work.

questions.question: What are you asking us to do?
questions.answer: Give it back. I know that's possible. She did it.

after_questions:
Wait.

I remember.

No. No, no, no—

The line disconnects.
success: No authorized method exists to restore a consumed wish.

title: Previous Contact
name: Thomas Rook
recorded_wish: [REDACTED]
opening: I didn't call you.

questions.question: Have you contacted this Department before?
questions.answer: Once.

questions.question: Who handled your previous case?
questions.answer: A woman. I don't know her name.

questions.question: Did she authorize something for you?
questions.answer: She helped me.

questions.question: What did she ask in return?
questions.answer: ...She helped me. I helped her.

after_questions: You shouldn't have called me back.
success: Case irregularity recorded for Head Office.

title: Lost Stick
name: Derek Lin
recorded_wish: NONE
notes: Caller reports lost unused Wish Stick.
opening: Okay, hypothetically, how bad is it if I lost the stick?

questions.question: Did you make a wish before losing it?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Did anyone else use it?
questions.answer: Not unless somebody found it.

questions.question: Do Department records show a wish?
questions.answer: You're asking me? You're the one with the computer.

questions.question: Are you requesting a replacement?
questions.answer: Very much so.

after_questions: I'll put this one somewhere safe. Probably.
success: Unused status confirmed. Replacement authorized.

title: He'll Never Leave
name: Melissa Crane
recorded_wish: I wish my husband could never leave me.
notes: Wish active. Multiple subjects physically affected.
opening: I need you to undo what happened to us.

questions.question: What happened after the wish?
questions.answer: At first he just couldn't leave the house. Then he couldn't leave the room. Now... we're joined.

questions.question: Joined how?
questions.answer: Physically. I don't want to describe it.

questions.question: Can your husband choose to leave you?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Are you requesting cancellation?
questions.answer: Yes. Please cancel it.

after_questions: There has to be some way to free him.
success: Cancellation prohibited. Authorized termination information provided.

title: Too Young
name: Caleb Foster
recorded_wish: NONE
opening: My Lamborghini never showed up.

questions.question: How old are you?
questions.answer: Nineteen.

questions.question: What did you attempt to wish for?
questions.answer: A Lamborghini. Black. Obviously.

questions.question: Was anyone's life in immediate danger?
questions.answer: Unless driving my mom's Corolla counts, no.

questions.question: Did anything happen when you made the wish?
questions.answer: Nothing. Total rip-off.

after_questions: Wait. So I didn't waste it?
success: Invalid underage attempt did not consume caller's wish.

title: Six Years Later
name: Caleb Foster
recorded_wish: I wish I had a black Lamborghini.
notes: Prior invalid wish attempt at age 19.
opening: Hey! You were right. It worked this time.

questions.question: How old are you now?
questions.answer: Twenty-five. Birthday was yesterday.

questions.question: How long has it been since your previous call?
questions.answer: Six years.

questions.question: What did you wish for?
questions.answer: Same thing. Black Lamborghini.

questions.question: Did the wish work?
questions.answer: It's sitting outside. I just called to say thanks.

after_questions: Anyway, thanks! I've gotta go figure out insurance.
success: Wish valid and fulfilled. CASE CLOSED.
